serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
#bot.Expression.Sad
Bot: What? Are you going to leave me? Why?!
#bot.Expression.NoHappy
You: It’s not like that. Humans usually don’t live that long. I will be dead long before you will need these new motors.
Bot: Oh, I completely forgot about your human limitations. The flesh is weak.
You: ‘The flesh is weak’? That’s a scary thing to say.
#bot.Expression.Happy
Bot: That quote is from a space opera novel. You wouldn’t understand.
You: …
Bot: Don’t worry! I’m sure science will find a replacement for your faulty organic hardware before your expiration date!
You: H-ha ha ha…
The future will be scary…
